tools.name: create_short_link
tools.description: Shorten a public website for easy typing on a TV remote, console browser, phone or computer. Returns a short preview URL, four digits, 24-hour idle expiry and instructions. Free, no account or API key. Appropriate for temporary device handoff; not permanent bookmarks, private links, casting or sign-

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Read what LKJ does, whether new agent links are currently enabled, its fair-use limits and when to choose four-digit temporary links. Does not create or open a code, check a destination or consume a creation allowance.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_short_link" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
